## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
Rotation, not Risk-On/Off. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. XLK in RECOVERY (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) while XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%); HYG (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -0.56%) and LQD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -1.26%) RECOVERY plus broad sector breadth confirm a ROTATION regime.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit stress easing: Credit Spread (0.7291) 1W: -0.25% → flat, HYG/LQD showing RECOVERY. Oil reflation driving risk assets: USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +39.13%) ABOVE TREND; VXX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) CORRECTION shows fear retreating this week.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-tight: Dollar strength (proxy) UUP (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND and yield curve (1W: +1.48%) ↑ rising with TLT (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Tech leadership but mixed breadth: XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY and XBI (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +2.01%) ABOVE TREND showing strength, while Energy XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION and Consumer Disc. (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND lag.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US holding up: SPY (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY; EM and China showing short-term recovery but still vulnerable: EEM (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -4.17%) RECOVERY, FXI (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.80%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation modestly rising: Speculation Index (1W: +2.56% | 1M: -4.00%) RECOVERY; ARKK (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -8.50%) RECOVERY but IBIT (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND signals crypto/speculative risk still constrained.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Commodity reflation intact: CPER (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -4.45%) RECOVERY and broad commodity ETFs PDBC (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND; precious metals GLD (1W: +7.18% | 1M: -8.98%) RECOVERY show short-term bid.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Oil rally pronounced in futures ETFs versus equity exposure: USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +39.13%) ABOVE TREND, while XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION highlights equity/fund-flow lag.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
Confirmed: Broad sector breadth (9/11) and rising HYG/LQD behavior; MAJOR divergence present as SPY (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -4.02%), XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) and TLT (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -2.26%) all show 1W vs 1M mismatch → MAJOR Divergence, so treat ROTATION as transitional.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor exposure to cyclical/real-economy reflation plays (USO/BNO, materials) and monitor tech momentum (XLK RECOVERY); reduce exposure to crypto/speculative ETFs like IBIT BELOW TREND and watch VXX/volatility.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Materials XLB (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) RECOVERY; Real Estate VNQ (1W: +3.94% | 1M: -4.05%) RECOVERY.  
BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND; Energy equities XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Oil USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND; Broad commodities PDBC (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -3.65%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX 34.70 (1W: -11.95% | 1M: +10.62%) CORRECTION = near-term fear pivot, SPY/TLT 7.5565 (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -1.65%) ↑ rising = stocks vs bonds sentinel, HYG/LQD ~0.73 (Credit Spread 1W: -0.25%) → credit health, XLK/market rotation ratio 2.7456 (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.05%) ↑ rising = tech vs cyclicals tilt.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive confirming broad participation, supported by HYG/LQD and sector-level rotation. Materials, real assets and select tech & biotech showing relative strength (XBI ABOVE TREND, XLK RECOVERY). Key risk is MAJOR short-term divergence (SPY/XLK/TLT 1W vs 1M mismatches) and persistent dispersion in volatility (VXX CORRECTION).
